summary: Iteration 25: Multi-Article Fusion and Deduplication Feature Testing Complete. All fusion-specific features verified working: GET /api/fusion/stats returns correct statistics (506 total items, 72 clustered, 30 unique clusters, 8.3% dedup ratio), POST /api/fusion/run triggers batch fusion successfully, GET /api/intelligence correctly filters to show only cluster primaries (464 visible items vs 506 total), fused items display cluster_size and cluster_sources with proper structure. Frontend shows 'X sources' badge on fused items with expandable panel showing all covering sources with links. Regression tests for P0 fixes (cross-border/daily-brief) all passed.
